dimensions.name: scope
dimensions.rationale: Bounded read-only discovery; no unrelated commands, mutations, services, frameworks, or databases.

dimensions.name: contract
dimensions.rationale: Collected-page search limits and exact-number lookup beyond collected pages are explicit; partial and unknown coverage remain visible.

dimensions.name: security
dimensions.rationale: Design retains configured-repository scope, connected-user authority checks, atomic source guards, and generation isolation.

dimensions.name: feasibility
dimensions.rationale: Plan reuses the existing workspace and #50 seams without claiming #50 source acceptance.

dimensions.name: tests
dimensions.rationale: Plan names source and browser regressions for bounds, failures, filters, unknown evidence, and accessibility.

dimensions.name: acceptance
dimensions.rationale: No actual source evidence, phone rehearsal, connected-user acceptance, or final Done status is claimed; these remain implementation gates.
